scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.profile: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && node --expose-gc scripts/profile.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w frontend && node scripts/build-pages.mjs && node scripts/verify-pages.mjs
scripts.smoke:pages: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build:pages && node scripts/smoke.mjs
